ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(-2.5, 2.5), y_range=(-4, 6))

beats.intent: The intervals x < -1 and x > 1 shaded green where the slope is positive
beats.narration: Where the slope curve is above zero, before minus one and after one, the cubic rises.
beats.code:
for a, b in ((-2.5, -1), (1, 2.5)):
    band = Rectangle(width=ax.c2p(b, 0)[0] - ax.c2p(a, 0)[0], height=0.25, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_width=0).move_to(ax.c2p((a + b) / 2, 0))
    stage.play(FadeIn(band), run_time=0.4)
    stage.add(band)

beats.intent: The interval -1 < x < 1 shaded red where the slope is negative
beats.narration: Between minus one and one the slope is negative, and the cubic falls.
beats.code:

stage.play(FadeIn(band))
stage.add(band)
stage.caption("f' > 0: rising.   f' < 0: falling")

beats.narration: Add one, take one away, add one, take one away. The running total jumps between one and zero.

beats.intent: A number line with the totals bouncing between 0 and 1
beats.narration: On a number line the total never settles: it bounces back and forth forever.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
nl = draw_number_line(stage, x_range=(-1, 2))
dot = Dot(nl.n2p(1), color=YELLOW, radius=0.12)
stage.play(FadeIn(dot))
for _ in range(3):
    stage.play(dot.animate.move_to(nl.n2p(0)), run_time=0.4)
    stage.play(dot.animate.move_to(nl.n2p(1)), run_time=0.4)
stage.add(dot)

beats.intent: The number line beside 'no limit: the series diverges'
beats.narration: The partial sums have no limit, so the series has no sum.

beats.code:
stage.title("The Sierpinski triangle")
A, B, C = np.array([-3, -2, 0]), np.array([3, -2, 0]), np.array([0, 3.2, 0])
t0 = Polygon(A, B, C, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8)
stage.play(FadeIn(t0))
stage.add(t0)

beats.intent: The middle triangle removed, leaving three
beats.narration: Cut out the middle triangle, joining the midpoints. Three triangles remain.
beats.code:
mid = lambda p, q: (p + q) / 2
hole = Polygon(mid(A, B), mid(B, C), mid(C, A), color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0)
stage.play(FadeIn(hole))
stage.add(hole)

beats.intent: The middle removed from each of the three, leaving nine, beside area × 3/4 each step
beats.narration: Do the same in each of those, and again, forever. Each step keeps three quarters of the area, so the area shrinks to nothing.
beats.code:
holes = VGroup()
for P, Q, R in ((A, mid(A, B), mid(A, C)), (mid(A, B), B, mid(B, C)), (mid(A, C), mid(B, C), C)):
    holes.add(Polygon(mid(P, Q), mid(Q, R), mid(R, P), color=BLACK, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0))
stage.play(FadeIn(holes))
stage.add(holes)
stage.equation(r"\text{area} \times \left(\tfrac34\right)^n \to 0")

request: why does the Koch snowflake have an infinite perimeter?

beats.intent: A single line segment of length 1
beats.code:
stage.title("The Koch curve")
koch = lambda pts: [q for p0, p1 in zip(pts, pts[1:]) for q in (p0, p0 + (p1 - p0) / 3, p0 + (p1 - p0) / 2 + np.array([-(p1 - p0)[1], (p1 - p0)[0], 0]) * np.sqrt(3) / 6, p0 + 2 * (p1 - p0) / 3)] + [pts[-1]]
pts = [np.array([-4.5, -1.5, 0]), np.array([4.5, -1.5, 0])]
c0 = VMobject(color=BLUE).set_points_as_corners(pts)
stage.play(Create(c0))
stage.add(c0)

beats.intent: The middle third replaced by a bump, making 4 pieces each 1/3 long
beats.narration: Replace the middle third with two sides of a triangle: four pieces, each a third long.

beats.intent: The rule applied twice more, a jagged snowflake edge, beside length × 4/3 each step
beats.narration: Do it again to every piece. Each step multiplies the length by four thirds, so it grows without limit.
beats.code:
p3 = koch(koch(p1))
c3 = VMobject(color=YELLOW).set_points_as_corners(p3)
stage.play(Transform(c0, c3))
stage.equation(r"L_n = \left(\tfrac43\right)^n \to \infty")

request: why doesn't |x| have a derivative at 0?

beats.intent: Axes with the V-shaped graph of y = |x|
beats.narration: Here is the absolute value: a V with its corner at zero.
beats.code:
stage.title("A corner has no slope")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(-3, 3), y_range=(-1, 3))
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, np.abs, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: Slope -1 on the left and slope +1 on the right shown with short tangent lines
beats.narration: To the left the slope is minus one; to the right, plus one.
beats.code:
l = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(-2.5, 2.5), ax.c2p(-1, 1), color=RED)
r = draw_line(stage, ax.c2p(1, 1), ax.c2p(2.5, 2.5), color=GREEN)
stage.label(l, "slope -1", direction=LEFT, color=RED)
stage.label(r, "slope +1", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: Several different lines through the corner, none fitting, beside 'no single tangent'
beats.narration: At the corner itself many lines touch it and none fits better: there is no single slope, so no derivative.
